name: AIと書いていない方は、応募できません。(更新版・最新仕様)

p_5a636418af.sentence: It may be too early to brace yourself for “At last, it’s time to compete over AI’s writing skills.”
p_5a636418af.prev: If you haven’t used it, you can’t apply.
p_5a636418af.next: What I’m curious about is not the writers, but the people giving the prize.

p_a420e7af85.sentence: Why did they go out of their way to create this kind of entrance?
p_a420e7af85.prev: What I’m curious about is not the writers, but the people giving the prize.
p_a420e7af85.next: The people behind the prize say it is an effort to ask other literary prizes, which are struggling with how to handle writers’ use of AI, a question.

p_ba14dd62f2.sentence: Where is the line between a helpful partner to talk things over with and a co-writer?
p_ba14dd62f2.prev: But how far can I go and still proudly say, “I wrote this”?
p_ba14dd62f2.next: So it would be a shame to reduce this prize to a simple choice: “Is AI good or bad?”

p_349677d9a6.sentence: A prize that is supposed to choose works also shines a light on the values of the people doing the choosing.
p_349677d9a6.prev: So it would be a shame to reduce this prize to a simple choice: “Is AI good or bad?”
p_349677d9a6.next: It makes the question of whether AI was used not the end of the discussion, but the starting point for reading.

p_17abb5c189.sentence: AI, which I thought was a helper behind the scenes, is now openly the ticket to enter.
p_17abb5c189.next: The Prix Pascal, whose creation was announced in France, is for unpublished fiction in French written jointly by a human and AI.

p_3eb562d767.sentence: The people behind the prize say it is an effort to ask other literary prizes, which are struggling with how to handle writers’ use of AI, a question.
p_3eb562d767.prev: Why did they go out of their way to create this kind of entrance?
p_3eb562d767.next: They create one prize and ask the others, “So, what would you do?”

p_d2ac42f431.sentence: For example, what if you were reading a story late into the night, and just after the last line moved you, you heard, “Actually, I wrote it with AI”?
p_d2ac42f431.prev: You might call it a question in the shape of a trophy.
p_d2ac42f431.next: Would a line that had seemed beautiful suddenly feel distant?

p_75c65aafc1.sentence: Or would you say, “I enjoyed it, so I have no complaint”?
p_75c65aafc1.prev: Would a line that had seemed beautiful suddenly feel distant?
p_75c65aafc1.next: A special judging meeting might begin inside the reader’s mind.

p_093fadc463.sentence: I might ask AI to fix a phrase or talk through the plot.
p_093fadc463.prev: But when I take the writer’s side, things suddenly get complicated.
p_093fadc463.next: But how far can I go and still proudly say, “I wrote this”?

p_c64b964db7.sentence: It makes the question of whether AI was used not the end of the discussion, but the starting point for reading.
p_c64b964db7.prev: A prize that is supposed to choose works also shines a light on the values of the people doing the choosing.
p_c64b964db7.next: It seems that writers are not the only ones being tested at this new entrance.

p_6f140c02b5.sentence: The Prix Pascal, whose creation was announced in France, is for unpublished fiction in French written jointly by a human and AI.
p_6f140c02b5.prev: AI, which I thought was a helper behind the scenes, is now openly the ticket to enter.
p_6f140c02b5.next: Using AI is not a bonus or an exception.

p_2cf02dded3.sentence: The Prix Pascal, whose creation was announced in France, is for unpublished fiction in French written jointly by a human and AI.
p_2cf02dded3.prev: AI, which I thought was a helper behind the scenes, is now openly the ticket to enter.
p_2cf02dded3.next: Using AI is not a bonus or an exception.

p_489998b2f1.sentence: What if the rules for entering a literary prize included a condition like this?
p_489998b2f1.prev: If You Didn’t Write with AI, You Can’t Apply
p_489998b2f1.next: Not “You may use AI,” but “Write together with AI.”

p_5d42ad1769.sentence: Using AI is not a bonus or an exception.
p_5d42ad1769.prev: The Prix Pascal, whose creation was announced in France, is for unpublished fiction in French written jointly by a human and AI.
p_5d42ad1769.next: If you haven’t used it, you can’t apply.

p_e3fb63980a.sentence: Of course, the label “co-written with AI” alone doesn’t guarantee an interesting story.
p_e3fb63980a.prev: A special judging meeting might begin inside the reader’s mind.
p_e3fb63980a.next: I wouldn’t decide I wanted to read it based on that alone, either.
